STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS * **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. Component rules consume `var(--...)` exclusively — raw hex values appear only inside token definitions. * **Required tokens:** the full color set above, plus `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 16px`, `--radius-lg: 28px`, `--radius-pill: 999px`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`, `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 200ms`, `--transition-normal: 250ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`, `--z-header: 900`, `--z-dropdown: 1000`, `--z-modal: 1100`, `--z-toast: 1200`. * **Light mode background:** cream `#EFE9D9` — never `#ffffff`; use `#fefefe` only where a near-white elevated surface is genuinely needed. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support * **Implementation:** (1) `:root` holds light tokens; (2) `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not(.light) { ... } }` holds dark tokens so first paint is correct without JS; (3) a `.dark` class on `` overrides for explicit user choice.
